discrepancies.parameter: Figure 4 timing diagram description (t_L1, t_L2, t_L3, t_L4 and LDAC pulses)
discrepancies.md_text: The LDAC signal is a pulse that coincides with the second BYTE0... t_L1 is the time from the falling edge of LDAC to the start of the output transition; t_L2 is the time from the falling edge of LDAC to the end of the output transition; t_L3 is the time from the rising edge of LDAC to the start of the output transition; and t_L4 is the time from the rising edge of LDAC to the end of the output transition.
discrepancies.pdf_text: Diagram shows two active-low LDAC pulses (first during first BYTE0, second across the boundary of second BYTE1 and second BYTE0); t_L1 is from falling edge to rising edge of first LDAC pulse; t_L2 is from first LDAC falling edge to the end of first BYTE0; t_L3 is from second LDAC falling edge to the end of second BYTE1; t_L4 is to the end of the OUTn transition.
